Life-Force Conversion

Ace's (Bungo Stray Dogs) supernatural ability - The Madness of the Jewel King allows him to convert the remaining life-span of his subordinates into gems of the same value.

Power/Ability to:

Convert/transform life energy into other type of matter/energy.

The power to convert life energy into another form of matter/energy. Sub-power of Life-Force Manipulation and Life-Force Absorption. Variation of Energy Conversion. Not to be confused with Life Conversion.

Also Called[]

  • Life Energy Conversion/Transmutation/Recomposition
  • Spiritual Energy Conversion/Transmutation/Recomposition

Capabilities[]

The user can convert their spiritual energy/life-force or those of others into any form of matter or energy for usage. Some users can cause their conversions to have certain characteristics and properties such as healing.

Applications[]

  • Convert life-force energy in different forms such as:
    • Cold
      • Ice
    • Cosmic
      • Lunar
      • Solar
      • Stellar
      • Time
    • Electricity
    • Heat
      • Fire
    • Gravity
    • Light
    • Magnetism
    • Kinetics
    • Plasma
    • Radiation
    • Sound
  • Life Energy Generation
    • Adrenal Activation
    • Enhanced Agility
    • Enhanced Speed
    • Enhanced Stamina
    • Enhanced Strength
  • Energy Generation

Variations[]

  • Aura Conversion
  • Chi Conversion
  • Soul Conversion

Advanced Applications[]

  • Energy Matter Manipulation
    • Energy/Omni-Energy Manipulation - Through life-force conversion users can manipulate all forms of energy.
    • Matter/Meta Matter Manipulation - Use life-force conversion to manipulate matter.
  • Spiritual Element Manipulation - Manipulate elements by internally converting one's spiritual energy/life-force into the chosen element or elemental mixture like electric-fire.
    • Elemental Manipulation/Omni-Element Manipulation

Associations[]

  • Aether Manipulation
  • Aura Manipulation
  • Chi Manipulation
  • Energy Channeling
  • Energy Conversion
  • Life Element Manipulation
  • Life-Force Manipulation
  • Mana Manipulation
  • Meta-Morphic Conversion
  • Power Concentration
  • Transmutation

Limitations[]

  • May only be able to convert life-force into certain types of energies and/or elements.
  • May only be able to use their own life-force.

Known Users[]

  • Shinobi (Naruto)
  • Yoruichi Shihoin (Bleach)
  • Users of Ki (Dragon Ball series)
  • Saji Genshirou (Highschool DxD); via Absorption Line
  • Transmuter Nen Users (Hunter x Hunter)
  • Code:Numbers (Code:Breaker)
  • Mages (Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha)
  • Various Characters (Black Cat)
  • Users of Spirit/Demon/Sacred Energy (Yu Yu Hakusho)
  • Ripple/Hamon Users (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)
  • Lee Jaha (Return of the Mad Demon)
  • Shade (Firewing)
  • Defilers (Dark Sun)
  • Preservers (Dark Sun)
  • Various Martial Artists (Wolyaverse)
  • Vortigaunts (Half-Life)

Known Objects[]

  • Palms (Kid Icarus: Uprising)
  • Lifejammer (Spelljammer)

Gallery[]

Yoruichi Shinhion (Bleach) when she enters her Shunkō: Raiju Senkei: Shunryū Kokubyō Senkei form, she is able to changes her Reishi properties 48 times every second.
While running the "Thunder Shock Surprise", Master Muten Rōshi (Dragon Ball) shoots a lightning blast towards his target using both hands and traps the opponent within an electric field.
Vegeta (Dragon Ball series) giving his ki blast the properties of a fireball.
The Chakra Nature Transformation system of the Naruto series. The ninja molds and defines their chakra into an innate type of chakra nature, altering its properties and characteristics to resemble certain elements.
Kakashi Hatake (Naruto) converting his chakra into lightning.
Pit's Palm weapons (Kid Icarus: Uprising) convert his life force into offensive energy blasts.
Humans and Demons (Yu Yu Hakusho) who wields either spirit or demon energy to form, mimic, and manipulate elements related to nature.
Vortigaunts (Half-Life) can convert the Vortessence into electricity.
Cheon Yeo Woon (Wolyaverse/Nano Machine) converting his chi into vicious amounts of black Extreme Yang and Extreme Yin.
